name: Savitri Devi
comment: I learned about OTP scams from this website. Two weeks later I got a fake call and I recognised it immediately and hung up. DigiSakhi saved my money!

name: Lakshmi Bai
comment: The Mobile Usage section is very easy to understand. I am 52 years old and never used WhatsApp properly. Now I run our SHG group on WhatsApp myself.

name: Fatima Begum
comment: The AI Safety section opened my eyes. I did not know that voices could be cloned. I have told all my family members about this.

name: Kamla Singh
comment: Reading real stories made me understand the danger. I shared DigiSakhi with my entire SHG group of 24 women. Everyone found it very helpful.

name: Pushpa Kumari
comment: When my cousin got scammed I used DigiSakhi to find out how to report it. We called 1930 and filed on cybercrime.gov.in. The money was partially recovered.

name: Durga Devi
comment: The WhatsApp safety rules section is excellent. I now know not to forward unverified messages. Very simple language, easy to understand.
